reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
)
SELECT pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue
FROM product_rev pr
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2
       WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
         AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id))) < 3

SELECT t.category_name, t.product_id, t.revenue
FROM (
  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY SUM(net_revenue_eur) DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.rn <= 3
